description: Apply a gradient fill to a Figma node. Supports LINEAR, RADIAL, ANGULAR (conic), and DIAMOND types. Replaces any existing fills. Stops must be sorted by position (0 → 1).

angle.description: Rotation in degrees — 0 = top→bottom, 90 = left→right (LINEAR and ANGULAR)

center.description: Focal point [cx, cy] in 0–1 node-relative coordinates (RADIAL and DIAMOND, default [0.5, 0.5])

gradientTransform.description: Raw 2×3 affine gradientTransform matrix — overrides angle/center when provided

stops.description: At least 2 colour stops, sorted by position 0→1

position.description: Stop position along the gradient (0 = start, 1 = end)

name: set_gradient_fill
